questions.text: A grocer marked his goods at 80% above their cost price and sold them at a discount of X%. If he gained 8% profit, then find the value of X.

Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum rate of interest for the period from 4 February 2023 to 18 April 2023.
A total profit of ₹27,600 is to be distributed amongst A, B and C such that A : B = 18 : 6 and B : C = 7 : 12. The share (in ₹) of C in the profit is:
P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 12 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 30 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?

A local cinema charges ₹150 per youth ticket and ₹250 per adult ticket. One evening, the theater sold a total of 200 tickets, collecting ₹38,000 in revenue. Find out how many youth tickets and how many adult tickets were sold?
